name: cytochrome P450 family 19 subfamily A member 1

function.text: CYP19A1 encodes aromatase. Annotated molecular activities include aromatase activity and electron transfer activity. It participates in androgen catabolic process and estrogen biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to aromatase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
